Item.Name: WORK_PHONE
Item.Hint: Enter work or home or mobile phone number with area code, no hyphens and no spaces.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 nNum number;
 h_phone_no varchar2(15);
begin
 begin
 if :ctrl_block.work_phone is not null then
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_block.work_phone), 0) < 10 then
 :ctrl_block.work_phone := null;
 show_error('18115');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif NVL(length(:ctrl_block.work_phone), 0) > 10 then
 :ctrl_block.work_phone := null;
 show_error('18141');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 nNum := to_number(:ctrl_block.work_phone);
 end if;
 exception
 when value_error then
 :ctrl_block.work_phone := null;
 show_error('18142');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 begin
 -- format only if length is 10 characters
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.work_phone', format_mask, '');
 if :ctrl_block.work_phone is not null then
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_block.work_phone), 0) = 10 then
 h_phone_no := substr(:ctrl_block.work_phone, 1, 3) || '-' ||
 substr(:ctrl_block.work_phone, 4, 3) || '-' ||
 substr(:ctrl_block.work_phone, 7);
 :ctrl_block.work_phone := h_phone_no;
 else
 -- stay put
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end;
end;

PROCEDURE filter_and_populate (rg_name varchar2,
 rg_id RecordGroup)IS

 id_gc Groupcolumn;
 nCurrRec number := 0;

 nTotalRecords number := 0;
 szDonorID varchar2(10) := '';
 szDonorName varchar2(100) := '';
 szDOB varchar2(15) := '';
 szABO_DESC varchar2(50) := ''; 
 szGender VARCHAR2(1);
 szDonorAddress varchar2(500) := '';
 nUnits number := 0;
 szLastDonationDate varchar2(15) := '';
 szLastUnitID varchar2(15) := '';
 szHomePhoneNo varchar2(25) := '';
 szMobilePhoneNo varchar2(25) := '';
 szDayPhoneNo varchar2(25) := '';
 lv_contact_flag varchar2(1);
 nCredits number := 0;
 szday varchar2(3) := '';
 l_intl_addr_flag varchar2(1);
 l_intl_addr varchar2(500); 
 l_h_ph varchar2(20); 
 l_m_ph varchar2(20); 
 l_w_ph varchar2(30); 
 
 mc_param_value VALID_PARAMETERS.parameter_value%TYPE;
 l_chapter_id VALID_PARAMETERS.chapter_id%TYPE;
 
 BEGIN
 nTotalRecords := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 message('Retrieving information.......', no_acknowledge);
 synchronize;
 id_data_rg := find_group('DATA_RECS');
 if not id_null(id_data_rg) then
 delete_group(id_data_rg);
 end if;

 id_data_rg := create_group('DATA_RECS');
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_ID' , CHAR_COLUMN, 10);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_NAME' , CHAR_COLUMN, 100);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_DOB' , DATE_COLUMN);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DOB_DAY' , CHAR_COLUMN, 3);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_GENDER' , CHAR_COLUMN, 1);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_ABO' , CHAR_COLUMN, 10);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_DONS' , NUMBER_COLUMN);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_GALS' , NUMBER_COLUMN);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_CREDITS' , NUMBER_COLUMN);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_LAST_DON' , DATE_COLUMN);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_LAST_UNIT', CHAR_COLUMN, 15);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_HOME' , CHAR_COLUMN, 25);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_WORK' , CHAR_COLUMN, 25);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_MOBILE' , CHAR_COLUMN, 25);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_ADDRESS' , CHAR_COLUMN, 200);

 for i in 1 .. nTotalRecords
 loop
 szDonorID := get_group_char_cell(rg_name || '.donor_id', i);
 /*szDonorName := DON_STD.DONOR_NAME(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id);
 szDOB := to_char(DON_STD.DONOR_DOB (szdonorID, :global.chapter_id), 'MM-DD-YYYY');
 szGender := DON_STD.DONOR_SEX(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id);
 
 szABO_DESC := DON_STD.DONOR_ABO(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id); */
 
 begin
 select a.last_name || decode(nvl(a.last_name_suffix, '0'), '0', '', ' ' || a.last_name_suffix) ||
 ', ' || a.first_name || ' ' || a.middle_name, 
 to_char(a.date_of_birth, 'MM-DD-YYYY'),
 a.gender, 
 upper(substr(rtrim(b.description), 1, 6))
 into szDonorName, szDOB, szGender, szABO_DESC
 from donors a, valid_master_codes b 
 where a.donor_id = szdonorID
 and b.code_type = 'ABO' 
 and b.code = nvl(a.blood_type, 'NONE') 
 and decode(a.chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, a.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and sysdate between b.eff_date 
 and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate+1);
 exception

 szDOB := null;
 szGender := null;
 szABO_DESC := null;
 end;
 /*szDonorAddress := DON_STD.DONOR_ADDRESS(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id);
 szHomePhoneNo := DON_STD.DONOR_HOME_PHONE(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id);
 szDayPhoneNo := DON_STD.DONOR_WORK_PHONE(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id); */

 into l_intl_addr_flag
 from donor_addresses
 where donor_id = szdonorID;
 Exception

 begin

 rtrim(a.street_name) || ' ' || rtrim(a.suite_apt) || ' ' || b.city || ', ' || b.state || ' ' || b.zip , 
 decode(a.h_phone_no, null, 'Not Available', 
 decode(a.h_area_code, null, 'Not Available', 
 '(H) ' || a.h_area_code || '-' || substr(a.h_phone_no, 1, 3) || '-' || substr(a.h_phone_no, 4))) ,

 '(W) ' || a.d_area_code || '-' || substr(a.d_phone_no, 1, 3) || '-' || substr(a.d_phone_no, 4))) || 
 decode(a.extension, null, '', ' #' || a.extension),
 decode(a.m_phone_no, null, 'Not Available', 
 decode(a.m_area_code, null, 'Not Available', 
 '(M) ' || a.m_area_code || '-' || substr(a.m_phone_no, 1, 3) || '-' || substr(a.m_phone_no, 4))) ,
 a.preferred_contact_flag

 and decode(a.chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, a.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and a.address_type = 'RES' 
 and b.usps_id = a.usps_id 
 and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate+1); 
 
 if lv_contact_flag = 'M' then
 szMobilePhoneNo := REPLACE(szMobilePhoneNo, '(M)', '(MP)'); 
 elsif lv_contact_flag = 'W' then
 szDayPhoneNo := REPLACE(szDayPhoneNo, '(W)', '(WP)');
 elsif lv_contact_flag = 'H' then
 szHomePhoneNo := REPLACE(szHomePhoneNo, '(H)', '(HP)');
 end if;
 else
 select /*+ index(valid_city_state valid_city_state_pk) */ 
 A.INTL_aDDRESS_1||decode(A.INTL_ADDRESS_2,null,null,', '||A.INTL_ADDRESS_2)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_3,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_3)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_4,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_4)||decode(A.COUNTRY_NAME,null,null,', '||A.COUNTRY_NAME)||decode(A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE,null,null,', '||A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE ) , 
 decode(INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO,null,'Not Available','(H)'||INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO) , 
 decode(INTL_MOBILE_PHONE_NO,null,'Not Available','(D)'||INTL_MOBILE_PHONE_NO)
 into szDonorAddress, szHomePhoneNo, szDayPhoneNo
 from donor_addresses a
 where a.donor_id = szdonorID
 and decode(a.chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, a.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and a.address_type = 'RES'; 
 
 --begin
 /* select /*+ index(valid_city_state valid_city_state_pk) */ 
 /* decode(nvl(a.intl_addr_flag,'N'),'N',rtrim(a.street_name) || ' ' || rtrim(a.suite_apt) || ' ' || b.city || ', ' || b.state || ' ' || b.zip,A.INTL_aDDRESS_1||decode(A.INTL_ADDRESS_2,null,null,', '||A.INTL_ADDRESS_2)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_3,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_3)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_4,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_4)||decode(A.COUNTRY_NAME,null,null,', '||A.COUNTRY_NAME)||decode(A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE,null,null,', '||A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE )) ,

 decode(a.h_area_code, null, 'Not Available', 
 '(H)' || a.h_area_code || '-' || substr(a.h_phone_no, 1, 3) || '-' || substr(a.h_phone_no, 4))),decode(INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO,null,'Not Available','(H)'||INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO)) , 
 decode(nvl(a.intl_addr_flag,'N'),'N',decode(a.d_phone_no, null, 'Not Available', 
 decode(a.d_area_code, null, 'Not Available', 
 '(B)' || a.d_area_code || '-' || substr(a.d_phone_no, 1, 3) || '-' || substr(a.d_phone_no, 4))) || 
 decode(a.extension, null, '', ' #' || a.extension),decode(INTL_MOBILE_PHONE_NO,null,'Not Available','(D)'||INTL_MOBILE_PHONE_NO))
 into szDonorAddress, szHomePhoneNo, szDayPhoneNo
 from donor_addresses a, valid_city_state b 
 where a.donor_id = szdonorID
 and decode(a.chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, a.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and a.address_type = 'RES' 
 and b.usps_id = a.usps_id 
 and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate+1);*/
 
 /* if nvl(l_intl_addr_flag,'N') = 'N' then
 szDonorAddress := szDonorAddress;
 szHomePhoneNo := szHomePhoneNo;
 szDayPhoneNo := szDayPhoneNo;
 
 else
 szDonorAddress := l_intl_addr;
 szHomePhoneNo := l_h_ph;
 szDayPhoneNo := l_m_ph; -- dont have field to give work phone.
 end if; */
 end if;
 
 exception
 when others then
 szDonorAddress := null;
 szHomePhoneNo := null;
 szDayPhoneNo := null;

 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 02/27/2012. IM 7078

 Select parameter_value

/*

*/

PROCEDURE populate_donors IS

 id_gc GroupColumn;
 nGroupRowCount number;
 nCurrGroupRow number;
 szColumns varchar2(200);
 szFrom varchar2(200);
 szWhereClause varchar2(1000);
 szQuery varchar2(2000);
 szPhoneNo varchar2(15);
 nRtnValue number;

BEGIN
 access_buttons_state(FALSE);
 message ('Checking search criteria...', no_acknowledge);
 synchronize;

-- szColumns := 'Select distinct donors.donor_id donor_id, donors.last_name, donors.first_name, donors.middle_name';
 szColumns := 'Select d.donor_id donor_id ';
 szFrom := 'donors d';
--MS szWhereClause := 'donors.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id';
 szWhereClause := 'decode(d.chapter_id, ''ALL'', :global.chapter_id, d.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id';

 /*
 ** check with last name and soundex key combination
 ** Options are - LIKE, SOUNDEX and EXACT
 */
 if :ctrl_block.last_name is not null then
-- if :ctrl_block.ck_soundex = 'Y' then
 if :ctrl_block.list_option = 'SOUNDEX' then
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause ||
 --' and donors.soundex_key = ' || in_quotes(soundex(upper(:ctrl_block.last_name))); -- Commented by Kishore on 09/25/2013. IM 9518
 ' and d.soundex_key = ' || in_quotes(soundex(upper(replace(:ctrl_block.last_name, '''', '''''')))); -- Added by Kishore on 09/25/2013. IM 9518
 elsif :ctrl_block.list_option = 'EXACT' then
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause ||
 --' and donors.last_name = ' || in_quotes(upper(:ctrl_block.last_name)); -- Commented by Kishore on 09/25/2013. IM 9518
 ' and d.last_name = ' || in_quotes(upper(replace(:ctrl_block.last_name, '''', ''''''))); -- Added by Kishore on 09/25/2013. IM 9518
 else -- 'LIKE'
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause ||
 --' and donors.last_name like ' || in_quotes(upper(:ctrl_block.last_name) || '%'); -- Commented by Kishore on 09/25/2013. IM 9518
 ' and d.last_name like ' || in_quotes(upper(replace(:ctrl_block.last_name, '''', '''''')) || '%'); -- Added by Kishore on 09/25/2013. IM 9518
 end if;
 end if;

 /*
 ** check dob information
 */
 if :ctrl_block.date_of_birth is not null then
 if NVL(length(szWhereClause), 0) > 1 then
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' and ' ;
 end if;
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' d.date_of_birth = ' ||
-- 'to_date(' || in_quotes(to_char(:ctrl_block.date_of_birth, 'DD-MON-YY')) || ')';
 'to_date(' || in_quotes(to_char(:ctrl_block.date_of_birth, 'DD-MON-YYYY')) || ', ''DD-MON-YYYY'' )';
 end if;

 /*
 ** check sex information
 */
 if :ctrl_block.donor_sex != 'E' then
 if NVL(length(szWhereClause), 0) > 1 then
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' and ' ;
 end if;
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' d.gender = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.donor_sex) ;
 end if;

 /*
 ** check first name
 */
 if :ctrl_block.first_name is not null then
 if NVL(length(szWhereClause), 0) > 1 then
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' and ' ;
 end if;
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || 'd.first_name like ' || in_quotes(upper(:ctrl_block.first_name) || '%');
 end if;

 /*
 ** check phone number
 -- V03 (mobile phone number search added as well) MLT 1950
 */
 if :ctrl_block.work_phone is not null then
 if NVL(length(szWhereClause), 0) > 1 then
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' and ' ;
 end if;
 szPhoneNo := replace(:ctrl_block.work_phone, '-');
 szFrom := szFrom || ', donor_addresses da';
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' da.donor_id = d.donor_id ' ||
 ' and (' || 
 ' (da.d_area_code = ' || in_quotes(substr(szPhoneNo, 1,3)) || ' and da.d_phone_no = ' || in_quotes(rtrim(substr(szPhoneNo, 4))) || ')' ||
 ' OR' ||
 ' (da.h_area_code = ' || in_quotes(substr(szPhoneNo, 1,3)) || ' and da.h_phone_no = ' || in_quotes(rtrim(substr(szPhoneNo, 4))) || ')' ||
 ' OR' ||
 ' (da.m_area_code = ' || in_quotes(substr(szPhoneNo, 1,3)) || ' and da.m_phone_no = ' || in_quotes(rtrim(substr(szPhoneNo, 4))) || ')' || 
 ')' ||
 ' and da.chapter_id = d.chapter_id' ;
 end if;
 
 /*
 ** check donor id
 */
 if :ctrl_block.donor_id is not null then
 if NVL(length(szWhereClause), 0) > 1 then
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' and ' ;
 end if;
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' d.donor_id = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.donor_id) ;
 end if;

 /*
 ** check old donor id
 */
 if :ctrl_block.old_donor_id is not null then
 if NVL(length(szWhereClause), 0) > 1 then
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' and ' ;
 end if;
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' d.previos_donor_id = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.old_donor_id) ;
 end if;

 /*
 ** check collection date
 */
 if :ctrl_block.collection_date is not null then
 if NVL(length(szWhereClause), 0) > 1 then
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' and ' ;
 end if;
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' d.donor_id in ' ||
 '( select distinct dn.donor_id from donations dn where dn.coll_date = ' ||
-- 'to_date(' || in_quotes(to_char(:ctrl_block.collection_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY')) || ')' ||
 'to_date(' || in_quotes(to_char(:ctrl_block.collection_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY')) || ', ''DD-MON-YYYY'' )' ||
 ' and decode(dn.chapter_id, ''ALL'', :global.chapter_id, dn.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id)';
--MS ' and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id)';

 end if;

 /*
 ** check unit id
 */
 if :ctrl_block.unit_id is not null then
 -- Added by Kishore on 09/17/2013. IM 9413
 if length(:ctrl_block.unit_id) = 15 then
 szUnitID := substr(:ctrl_block.unit_id, 1, 13);
 else
 szUnitID := :ctrl_block.unit_id;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 if NVL(length(szWhereClause), 0) > 1 then
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' and ' ;
 end if;
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 09/17/2013. IM 9413
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' donors.donor_id in ' ||
 '( select distinct donor_id from donations where unit_id = ' ||
 in_quotes(:ctrl_block.unit_id) || ' and decode(donations.chapter_id, ''ALL'', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id)';
--MS in_quotes(:ctrl_block.unit_id) || ' and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id)';
 -- End of commented section */
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 09/17/2013. IM 9413
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' d.donor_id in ' ||
 '( select distinct donor_id from donations dn1 where dn1.unit_id = ' ||
 in_quotes(szUnitID) || 
 ' and decode(dn1.chapter_id, ''ALL'', :global.chapter_id, dn1.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id)';
 -- End of change

 end if;

 if not get_estimate_ok(szFrom, szWhereClause) then
 clear_message;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || ' order by d.last_name, d.first_name, d.middle_name';
 /*
 ** form the query and then populate the record group
 */
 szQuery := szColumns || ' from ' || szFrom || ' where ' || szWhereClause;
 :dispaly:=szQuery;
 --message(substr(szQuery,1,220));
 --message(substr(szQuery,221,200));
 
 if :ctrl_block.show_sql = 'TRUE' then
 show_debug_window(szquery);
 end if;

 /*
 ** find, and if exists, delete record group
 */
 id_rg := find_group('MULTI_SELECT_TMP');
 if not id_null(id_rg) then
 delete_group(id_rg);
 end if;
 --message('1');
 id_rg := create_group_from_query('MULTI_SELECT_TMP', szQuery);
 -- message('2');
 nRtnValue := populate_group(id_rg);

 -- message('3');

 if get_group_row_count(id_rg) > 0 then
 message ('Your selection criteria retrieved ' || to_char(get_group_row_count(id_rg)) || ' records.', no_acknowledge);
 synchronize;
 -- message('4');
 filter_and_populate('MULTI_SELECT_TMP', id_rg);
 -- message('5');
 else
 message ('Your selection criteria did not retrieve any records.', no_acknowledge);
 show_error( '9188');
 go_item('ctrl_block.last_name');
 set_application_property(cursor_style, 'DEFAULT');
 synchronize;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** this procedure will load data onto the screen
*/

PROCEDURE sort_data (rg_name varchar2,
 id_data_rg RecordGroup) IS

 szCurrVal varchar2(100) := ''; -- current value
 szNextVal varchar2(100) := ''; -- next value 
 nTotalRecords number := 0; -- total records
 nCounter1 number := 0; -- first counter
 nCounter2 number := 0; -- second counter
 nCurrRec number := 0; -- current record pointer
BEGIN

 /*
 ** first we find number of records in the recordgroup
 */

 nTotalRecords := get_group_row_count(id_data_rg);
 message('Sorting data.......', no_acknowledge);
 synchronize;

 go_block('donors');
 set_block_property('donors', insert_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('donors', delete_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('donors', update_allowed, property_true);
 clear_block(no_validate);

 nTotalRecords := get_group_row_count(id_data_rg);
 for i in 1 .. nTotalRecords
 loop
 create_record;
 :donors.donor_id := get_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_ID' , i);
 :donors.donor_name := get_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_NAME' , i);
 :donors.gender := get_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_GENDER' , i);
 :donors.date_of_birth := get_group_date_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_DOB' , i);
 :donors.dob_day := get_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DOB_DAY' , i);
 :donors.total_donations := get_group_number_cell('DATA_RECS.DONOR_DONS' , i);
 :donors.total_credits := get_group_number_cell('DATA_RECS.DONOR_CREDITS' , i);
 :donors.total_gallons := get_group_number_cell('DATA_RECS.DONOR_GALS' , i);
 :donors.last_donation_date := get_group_date_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_LAST_DON' , i);
 :donors.last_unit_id := get_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_LAST_UNIT', i);
 :donors.home_phone_no := get_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_HOME' , i);
 :donors.day_phone_no := get_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_WORK' , i);
 :donors.mobile_phone_no := get_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_MOBILE' , i);
 :donors.donor_address := initcap(get_group_char_cell('DATA_RECS.DONOR_ADDRESS' , i));

 if substr(get_group_char_cell('DATA_RECS.DONOR_ABO', i), 1, 1) = 'N' then
 :donors.blood_type := 'N/A';
 else
 :donors.blood_type := substr(replace(get_group_char_cell('DATA_RECS.DONOR_ABO', i), ' '), 1, 6);
 end if;
 end loop;
 set_block_property('donors', insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_block_property('donors', delete_allowed, property_false);
 set_block_property('donors', update_allowed, property_false);
 go_record(1);
 message('Total ' || to_char(ntotalRecords) || ' records retrieved.', no_acknowledge);
 access_buttons_state(TRUE);
 synchronize;
END;

FUNCTION get_estimate_ok (szFrom varchar2, szWhereString varchar2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 id_rg RecordGroup;
 nGroupRowCount number;
 szQuery varchar2(1000);
 nRtnValue number;

BEGIN
 /*
 ** find, and if exists, delete record group
 */
 id_rg := find_group('ROW_ESTIMATE');
 if not id_null(id_rg) then
 delete_group(id_rg);
 end if;
 szQuery := 'select count(*) donor_count';
 szQuery := szquery || ' from ' || szFrom || ' where ' || szWhereString ;

 nRtnValue := populate_group(id_rg);

 nGroupRowCount := get_group_number_cell('ROW_ESTIMATE.donor_count', 1);
 if nGroupRowCount > :ctrl_block.max_rows_limit then

 to_char(nGroupRowCount) || ' donors. Please provide ' || 
 'additional search criteria.');
 nRtnValue := show_alert('ESTIMATE_ALERT');
 synchronize;
 return FALSE;
 end if;
 return TRUE;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE DON_STD_LOCAL IS
/****
local pkg added for SCR 20580 - Dt: 06/18/2014. Only difference from the db pkg (don_std) is the removal of chapter id condition
for donation queries. Chapter ID condition restricts only to the logged in chapter, and so is not giving an accurate total count.
****/

/*
** this function calculates various lifetime counts on donations
*/
FUNCTION donor_life_counts
 (p_what IN varchar2,
 szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type)
 RETURN NUMBER;


/*
** Donors lifetime donations unit count is calculated and returned.
*/
FUNCTION donor_life_unit_count
 (szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type) RETURN NUMBER;



/*
** Donors lifetime donations credit count is calculated and returned.
*/
FUNCTION donor_life_credit_count
 (szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type) RETURN NUMBER;

 
/*
** Date of last successful donation is returned.
*/
FUNCTION last_donation_date
 (szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type) RETURN DATE;



/*
** Unit ID of last successful donation is returned.
*/
FUNCTION last_donation_unit_id
 (szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type) RETURN VARCHAR2;
 
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DON_STD_LOCAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY DON_STD_LOCAL IS
 FUNCTION donor_life_counts
 (p_what IN varchar2,
 szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type)
 RETURN NUMBER IS

 UNIT_NAME varchar2(32) := null;
 szErrorMsg varchar2(500) := null;
 nDonorCount NUMBER;
 nUnitCount NUMBER;
 nDeferralCount NUMBER; --Added by Lakshmi on 01/19/98
 nCreditCount NUMBER;
 nClaimedDons NUMBER;
 szdonor varchar2(10);

 cursor cur_donation (p_donor_id varchar2, p_chapter_id varchar2) is
 select donor_id, count(unit_id), nvl(sum(donations.credit_count),0)
 from donations
 where donor_id = p_donor_id
 --and --chapter_id = p_chapter_id -- IM5237 -- SCR 20580 06/18/2014
 --DECODE(chapter_id,'ALL',p_chapter_id,chapter_id) = p_chapter_id -- SCR 20580 06/18/2014
 and unit_id is not null
 and donation_type!='SM'
 group by donor_id;

 -- Added by Lakshmi on 01/19/98 as req by Goudar

 cursor cur_deferral (p_donor_id varchar2, p_chapter_id varchar2) is
 select donor_id, count(*)
 from donations
 where donor_id = p_donor_id
 --and --chapter_id = p_chapter_id -- IM5237 -- SCR 20580 06/18/2014
 --DECODE(chapter_id,'ALL',p_chapter_id,chapter_id) = p_chapter_id -- SCR 20580 06/18/2014
 and unit_id is null
 group by donor_id;

 cursor cur_claimed (p_donor_id varchar2, p_chapter_id varchar2) is
 select nvl(donors.claimed_donation, 0)
 from donors
 where donor_id = p_donor_id
 and --chapter_id = p_chapter_id -- IM5237
 DECODE(chapter_id,'ALL',p_chapter_id,chapter_id) = p_chapter_id;

 BEGIN
 UNIT_NAME := 'donor_life_count';
 open cur_donation(szDonorID, szChapterID);
 fetch cur_donation
 into szdonor, nUnitCount, nCreditCount;
 if cur_donation%NOTFOUND then
 nUnitCount := 0;
 nCreditCount := 0;
 end if;
 if cur_donation%ISOPEN then
 close cur_donation;
 end if;

 open cur_deferral(szDonorID, szChapterID);
 fetch cur_deferral
 into szdonor, nDeferralCount;
 if cur_deferral%NOTFOUND then
 nDeferralCount := 0;
 end if;
 if cur_deferral%ISOPEN then
 close cur_deferral;
 end if;

 open cur_claimed(szDonorID, szChapterID);
 fetch cur_claimed
 into nClaimedDons;
 if cur_claimed%NOTFOUND then
 nClaimedDons := 0;
 end if;
 if cur_claimed%ISOPEN then
 close cur_claimed;
 end if;

 if p_what = 'CREDIT' then
 nDonorCount := nCreditCount + nClaimedDons;
 elsif p_what = 'GALLON' then
 nDonorCount := FLOOR((nCreditCount + nClaimedDons)/8);
 elsif p_what = 'UNIT' then
 nDonorCount := nUnitCount;
 elsif p_what ='DEFER' then
 nDonorCount := nDeferralCount;
 end if;
 return nDonorCount;

 -- exception handing
 exception
 when others then
 null;

 END donor_life_counts; 


/*
** Donors lifetime donations unit count is calculated and returned.
*/
 FUNCTION donor_life_unit_count
 (szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type) RETURN NUMBER IS
 BEGIN
 return donor_life_counts('UNIT', szDonorID, szChapterID);
 END donor_life_unit_count;
 
 
/*
** Donors lifetime donations credit count is calculated and returned.
*/
 FUNCTION donor_life_credit_count
 (szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type) RETURN NUMBER IS
 BEGIN
 return donor_life_counts('CREDIT', szDonorID, szChapterID);
 END donor_life_credit_count; 

 FUNCTION last_donation_date
 (szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type) RETURN DATE IS

 UNIT_NAME varchar2(32) := null;
 szErrorMsg varchar2(500) := null;
 szLastDonationDate date;

 cursor cur_last_donation (p_donor_id varchar2, p_chapter_id varchar2) is
 select max(coll_date)
 from donations
 where donor_id = p_donor_id
 -- and --chapter_id = p_chapter_id -- IM5237 -- SCR 20580 06/18/2014
 -- DECODE(chapter_id,'ALL',p_chapter_id,chapter_id) = p_chapter_id -- SCR 20580 06/18/2014
 and unit_id is not null;

 BEGIN
 UNIT_NAME := 'last_donation_date';
 open cur_last_donation(szDonorID, szChapterID);
 fetch cur_last_donation
 into szLastDonationDate;
 if cur_last_donation%NOTFOUND then
 szLastDonationdate := NULL;
 end if;
 if cur_last_donation%ISOPEN then
 close cur_last_donation;
 end if;

 return szLastDonationDate;

 -- exception handing
 exception
 when others then
 null;

 END last_donation_date;

/*
** Unit ID of last successful donation is returned.
*/
 FUNCTION last_donation_unit_id
 (szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS

 UNIT_NAME varchar2(32) := null;
 szErrorMsg varchar2(500) := null;
 szLastUnitID varchar2(15);
 szLastCollDate date := last_donation_date(szDonorID, szChapterID);

 cursor cur_last_donation (p_donor_id varchar2,
 p_chapter_id varchar2,
 p_coll_date date) is
 select unit_id
 from donations
 where donor_id = p_donor_id
 -- and --chapter_id = p_chapter_id -- IM5237 -- SCR 20580 06/18/2014
 -- DECODE(chapter_id,'ALL',p_chapter_id,chapter_id) = p_chapter_id -- SCR 20580 06/18/2014
 and coll_date = p_coll_date;


 BEGIN
 UNIT_NAME := 'last_donation_unit_id';
 open cur_last_donation(szDonorID, szChapterID, szLastCollDate);
 fetch cur_last_donation
 into szLastUnitID;
 if cur_last_donation%NOTFOUND then
 szLastUnitID := NULL;
 end if;
 if cur_last_donation%ISOPEN then
 close cur_last_donation;
 end if;

 return szLastUnitID;

 -- exception handing
 exception
 when others then
 null;

 END last_donation_unit_id;

 
END;
